findings.claim: the ordinary-merge false-positive half of this fix (merges of already-footered branches must PASS) carries no machine pin: the recorded pin spends its discriminating RED on the two refusal halves (root smuggle, evil merge), and the pass-half was only ever red before the fix, when no pin was recorded
findings.proof: a regression that re-flags ordinary merges would pass every recorded check: the pin asserts refusals that would still hold, the battery never runs checkRange, and CI's fence step only audits this repo's own linear history — nothing machine-verifies 'a legal merge passes' until a real merge push happens

findings.justification: the octopus intersection is three lines of containment over per-parent diffs, review-verified against the two-parent live probes on both sides (refuse beyond-parents, pass ordinary); this repo and its CI history contain no octopus merges, and a live probe would pin git plumbing rather than law
